description: Imports subscription-billing data (customers, subscriptions, invoices, transactions, credit notes, plans/items, events and related objects) from a Chargebee site.

placeholders.site: the `site` endpoint-config field — the customer's Chargebee site prefix

spec.apiVersionPinning: path segment `/api/v2` baked into every request URL

continuity.notes: Pure read-only HTTP polling; nothing is created on the customer's Chargebee site. Incremental state is a unix-second cursor stored by the connector and windows are re-derived from it, so an arbitrarily long pause is safe: on resume the connector walks forward one day at a time from the stored cursor. A 5-minute lag is subtracted from `now` to absorb Chargebee's documented eventual-consistency delay, and windows shorter than 1 minute are skipped.

configFields.name: credentials.api_key
configFields.description: Chargebee API key; sent as the HTTP Basic username.

configFields.name: credentials.password
configFields.description: Always blank for Chargebee authentication; defaults to an empty string.

configFields.name: site
configFields.description: The site prefix of the Chargebee account; substituted into the base URL.

configFields.name: start_date
configFields.description: UTC datetime; data older than this is not replicated. Defaults to 30 days before now; must not be in the future.

configFields.name: product_catalog
configFields.description: "1.0" or "2.0"; selects which stream set is offered. Cannot be changed after the capture is created.

configFields.name: advanced.limit
configFields.description: Page size sent as the `limit` query param. Default 100, must be >0 and <=100.

configFields.name: name
configFields.description: Name of the bound resource (CDK ResourceConfig).

configFields.name: interval
configFields.description: ISO-8601 duration between updates for this resource (CDK ResourceConfig).

authTierRationale: The only credential mode is a single self-serve Chargebee API key, pasted into one field and sent as HTTP Basic auth with an empty password (the CDK base64-encodes `api_key:`). No OAuth app registration and no refresh token are involved — `TokenSource` is constructed with `oauth_spec=None`.

unionMisfits.description: The incremental filter is not a single lower-bound parameter but a closed RANGE encoded into one query param, `<cursor_field>[between]` whose value is the literal string `[<start_epoch>,<end_epoch>]`. Both ends move: the incremental leg walks a bounded window (cursor -> min(cursor+1 day, now-5min)) rather than sending an open-ended `since`. The schema's {param, format} shape cannot express the upper bound, the window size, or the consistency lag.

Two gates decide whether a stream is offered at all, and neither has a home in the schema: (a) `product_catalog` ("1.0" vs "2.0") selects between two shipped stream lists — addons/plans exist only in 1.0, items/item_prices/item_families/attached_items/differential_prices only in 2.0; (b) RESTRICTED_RESOURCES (quotes, quote_line_groups) are probed at discovery with a limit=1 request and dropped on HTTP 404 because they need a Performance/Enterprise Chargebee plan. The list is static, but conditionally static. I added a non-schema `availability` object per stream to carry this rather than silently dropping it.

Ordering is a per-stream property that is neither the cursor nor a paginator field: the sort key can differ from the cursor field (coupons cursor on updated_at but sort by created_at; credit_notes and quotes cursor on updated_at but sort by date), and six streams (hosted_pages, promotional_credits, virtual_bank_accounts, addons, plans, item_families, attached_items) disable sorting entirely because the Chargebee endpoint does not support it. There is no `sortKey`/`sortSupported` field in the schema.

The three associated streams require a full parent sweep before any child request: the connector paginates the entire parent collection (optionally filtered) into an in-memory id list, then issues one child request per parent id. `pathPlaceholders` names the placeholder but cannot express that a second, separately-paginated HTTP pull is a prerequisite of the first, nor that the parent listing is re-walked on every single incremental tick.

parentPull.materialization: full in-memory id list per invocation

unionMisfits.description: Incremental streams are `merge` but also emit hard deletes: the incremental leg sets include_deleted=true and rewrites any record whose `deleted` field is true into a document with _meta.op="d". That is merge-plus-tombstone, which the three-value enum does not distinguish from a plain merge.

proposedShape.deleteSignal: record field `deleted` == true, requested via include_deleted=true

abstained.transports[0].spec.defaultHeaders: No headers are set by the connector beyond the CDK-injected `Authorization`; the CDK's shared HTTP session adds nothing connector-specific. Recorded as null rather than inventing a User-Agent.
abstained.discovery: There is no runtime schema/catalog discovery. `discover` returns the shipped stream list (filtered by product_catalog and a 404 probe for plan-gated resources), so this is a static list, not discovery. The 404 probe is recorded in unionMisfits and per-stream `availability` instead of being dressed up as a discovery method.
abstained.execution.defaultSchedule: Scheduling is entirely per-binding (`initial_config=ResourceConfig(interval=...)`); the connector declares no connector-wide default, so this is genuinely null rather than unknown.
abstained.streams[].pull.*.paginator.pageSize (per: The literal 100 is the DEFAULT of `advanced.limit`, not a hard-coded page size — the user may lower it (bounded 0 < limit <= 100). Recorded as 100 with `limitParam: limit` so a reader knows it is configurable.
abstained.streams[subscriptions_with_scheduled_cha: This endpoint is declared `returns_list=False`, so the response has no `list` envelope; the CDK model's `handle_single_object` validator wraps the bare object into a synthetic one-element list before parsing. There is no real records path in the wire response, so it is null.
abstained.streams[].pull.*.params (exact wire valu: Query-param VALUES are computed at runtime from config and cursor state (site, limit, epoch window bounds). I recorded parameter NAMES verbatim and described the values in angle brackets rather than fabricating literals.
abstained.streams[quote_line_groups].pull / stream: These two names appear only as strings in the full-refresh lists; no model class or endpoint-shape code exists for them beyond the generic `/{name}` snapshot path, so the pull shape is asserted only to the extent the generic snapshot function guarantees it.
abstained.streams[].pull.backfill vs incremental f: Full-refresh and associated-full-refresh bindings are opened with `fetch_snapshot` only (no fetch_page/fetch_changes), so they are recorded under `snapshot` and both other legs are null, per schema rule v2.1.
